### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. E.g., *"Current detectors struggle with compressed H.265 social media videos..."*

### Proposed Solution
A clear description of the new forensic methodology, deep learning architecture, or UI component you propose.

### Academic / Theoretical Reference
If this is a forensic detection algorithm, please provide the relevant paper citation or arXiv link (e.g. *Author et al. (CVPR 2024)*).

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or tensor architectural diagrams here.
